tasks.short: Investigate ecosystem effects of changed land management.

steps.what: Collect actual site observations and inspect changed land management practices
Record observations and reconcile land-use history and ecological measurements
Prepare selected before-and-after comparisons in ecological analysis software
Interpret ecosystem changes, competing causes and uncertainty
Write and check actual findings and methodological qualifications
Save final ecosystem findings

tasks.design: Configure native import mappings and saved comparisons in {OTHER} ecological analysis software. Keep actual observation capture, comparison choices and ecological interpretation human; no causal conclusion follows automatically from a changed map.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source reconciliation and comparison setup.
tasks.enabler_now: Native imports and reusable comparison recipes.
tasks.still_hard: Separating management effects from weather, baseline differences and other causes.
tasks.human_edge: Judge ecological mechanisms and uncertainty at the actual sites.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated preparation; ecosystem interpretation unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: ecological analysis software can reuse imports and comparison recipes while field observation and causal interpretation remain scientific work.

assumptions: Boundary includes field observation through own findings record. Ecologist captures site, date, practice, observation and uncertainty in s1/s2. Land manager supplies actual treatment dates and extents; measurement producers supply variable, value, unit and method. Ecologist selects comparison design in s3 before calculations; missing data is manually reconciled in s2 or left unknown.

Native first; only repeated reconciliation within s2 reduces, actual observation entry remains within its75 percent. Only repeated setup within s3 reduces; analysis choices remain. Existing native recipes earn zero saving. Shares provisional; field35, interpretation25, findings4 and save1 unchanged.
unknowns: Actual repeat comparison effort and site-data completeness
research_questions: Can native recipes preserve actual comparison groups and missing observations?

incremental.description: Maintain site-data mappings and comparison recipes

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete checked final ecosystem findings

tasks.short: Develop and test ecological monitoring protocols.

steps.what: Read monitoring objectives, site constraints and existing protocol evidence
Choose indicators, sampling methods, frequency and quality criteria
Write and check the pilot protocol and field collection forms
outputs: checked final pilot protocol and forms

steps.what: Save the final pilot protocol and collection forms
inputs: checked final pilot protocol and forms

steps.what: Conduct actual pilot measurements and evaluate protocol practicality and ecological sensitivity
outputs: actual pilot observations and protocol findings

steps.what: Record actual pilot results and check resulting protocol revisions
inputs: actual pilot observations and protocol findings
outputs: checked final pilot record and revised protocol

steps.what: Save the actual pilot record and revised protocol
inputs: checked final pilot record and revised protocol
outputs: saved pilot record and revised protocol

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} protocol headings and collection-form fields. Ecologist selects the monitoring design and tests it in the ecosystem; pilot results and revisions are recorded only after actual observations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated protocol layout and field-form construction.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable native protocol and form fields.
tasks.still_hard: Whether indicators and methods detect meaningful ecological change.
tasks.human_edge: Choose sensitive methods that work under actual field conditions.
tasks.altitude: Less protocol formatting; method development and testing unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: reusable document and form fields reduce protocol formatting without demonstrating ecological validity.

assumptions: Boundary is protocol development and its actual pilot, not a complete monitoring campaign. Study owner supplies objectives and site constraints; ecologist selects indicator, unit, location rule, method, frequency and quality criteria in s2 and enters them in s3. Actual pilot measurements are produced in s5 and captured in s6. Missing measurements stay missing and require manual investigation.

Native first; only repeated layout within protocol14 reduces. Existing forms yield zero saving. Provisional shares unmeasured; evidence15, design30, actual pilot30, outcome/revision9 and both saves1 remain. Normal checking during actual writing supplies final-version gates without added approval ceremony.
unknowns: Current protocol templates and actual layout burden
research_questions: Which form fields can be reused without fixing the scientific method prematurely?

incremental.description: Maintain actual protocol and field-form templates

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete checked final pilot protocol and forms
s6 complete checked actual pilot record and revised protocol

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional protocol14 reduced20 percent saves2.8 minus0.5 upkeep=2.3; half eligible repeated forms gives0.9. Objectives15, design30, actual pilot30, outcome9 and both saves1 unchanged.

tasks.short: Research environmental effects of land and water use.

steps.what: Examine actual land and water use and collect environmental observations
Capture observations and reconcile actual usage, yield and environmental datasets
Prepare scientist-selected comparisons in ecological analysis software
Judge environmental mechanisms, output trade-offs and credible improvement methods
Write and check actual findings and limits of proposed improvements
Save final land-water research findings

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} analysis imports and reusable land-water comparison recipes. Keep actual observations, study choices and improvement judgements human; no higher yield or environmental benefit is assumed from a calculation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated dataset reconciliation and comparison setup.
tasks.enabler_now: Native imports and saved analytical views.
tasks.still_hard: Confounding, seasonal variation and competing environmental and production goals.
tasks.human_edge: Choose improvement methods supported by the actual ecosystem evidence.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated analysis preparation; improvement judgement unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: ecological analysis software can repeat mapped comparisons without proving a land or water intervention improves yields or environmental conditions.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual investigation and findings record. Land/water managers supply dated usage, location, quantity and unit; crop or production owner supplies actual yield data; measurement owners supply method and quality metadata. Ecologist captures own observations in s2, resolves gaps manually and selects comparison assumptions in s3 before calculation. No free classified intervention dataset.

Native first. Only repeated reconciliation reduces s2, observation entry retained within75 percent; s3 retains comparison choices and bespoke analysis within60 percent. Existing automation/runtime earns zero. Provisional shares not measured; field30, judgement25, findings4 and save1 unchanged.
unknowns: Comparable usage/yield data and actual manual repetition
research_questions: Can saved recipes retain uncertainty and avoid treating association as intervention effect?

incremental.description: Maintain usage/yield mappings and comparison recipes

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete checked final land-water findings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional dataset20 reduced25 percent saves5 and comparison20 reduced40 percent saves8 minus1.5 upkeep=11.5. Half eligible repeated analysis gives5; field30, judgement25, findings4 and save1 unchanged.

tasks.short: Provide managers with environmental technical materials.

steps.what: Locate current technical evidence, regulatory guidance and the manager's actual issue
Select applicable technical points, limitations and required compliance actions
Prepare technical materials with actual source links and selected guidance
Check complete final materials, source currency and intended manager recipient
outputs: checked final technical materials and recipient

steps.what: Send the checked final materials to the designated industrial manager
inputs: checked final technical materials and recipient

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} current-guidance views and briefing layouts with source links. The ecologist decides applicability, writes issue-specific advice and checks complete materials before a separate internal send; no compliance decision is inferred from retrieved guidance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated current-source retrieval and briefing layout.
tasks.enabler_now: Native version views and reusable fields.
tasks.still_hard: Applying environmental guidance to the manager's actual situation.
tasks.human_edge: Explain practical implications and uncertainty accurately.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated materials preparation; applicability judgement unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native guidance views and briefing layouts reduce retrieval and formatting without deciding regulatory applicability.

assumptions: Boundary is providing written technical materials to an internal manager. Manager supplies actual question and operation; compliance owner supplies current guidance version and scope; evidence producers supply referenced actual results. Ecologist resolves missing context manually in s1 and selects the technical content in s2. No free applicability tags or fabricated compliance actions.

Native first; existing configuration earns zero saving. Provisional s3 savings cover repeated layout/source links only, actual advice remains. Ordinary final materials check15 and send1 retained; external managers require act_external and the same exact-version gate. Shares unmeasured.
unknowns: Current guidance views and repetitive formatting share
research_questions: Can native links keep superseded guidance out of actual briefings?

incremental.description: Maintain guidance views and briefing field mappings

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete checked final technical materials and internal manager recipient
